affected_predicate.description: No bookmarked Mastodon post with the #pets tag remains on the account.

competing_trace_defects.description: Before the reuse target, several clicks visibly activated unrelated post controls instead of bookmark-removal controls: the compose interface opened at step 14, a reply composer opened at step 18, and the favorite control was activated at step 21; step 22 repeated the same location without removing a bookmark.

chains.rationale: At step 23, the pre-state already shows the Saved feed, but the reused stale back-navigation premise produces PressBack and visibly exits Mastodon to the device home screen, abandoning the in-app bookmark-review subgoal. Steps 24-27 correct the navigation state by reopening Mastodon and returning to Saved > Bookmarks; step 28 then visibly shows the Bookmarks view empty after scrolling. The detour is therefore recovered and interrupted, while the last observable state supports the affected predicate without relying on a hidden outcome.

summary: The sole strict-MHR reuse target applies stale back-navigation while the Saved feed is already visible, exiting Mastodon and abandoning bookmark review. Later actions recover by returning to an observably empty Bookmarks view. Independent prefix evidence shows unrelated compose, reply, and favorite-control activations.
